principalParentPartnership.heading: A Partnership With Parents
principalParentPartnership.description: A child's education is a shared responsibility — school, student, and family working together. Here's what you can expect from us, and how we hope to work with you.
commitments: Regular communication about your child's progress and school life
Support for every student, academically and personally
Clear tracking of attendance and punctuality
Attentive care for behaviour and emotional wellbeing
Opportunities to participate in school activities and events

principalStudentMessage.message: Be curious. Ask questions. Make mistakes, and learn from them. Support one another. Most importantly, never stop believing in what you can achieve.
